Package placement

Class Internship

java.lang.Object
placement.Internship
public class Internship extends Object
Represents an internship opportunity posted by a CompanyRep. This class holds all details about the internship, manages its status (InternshipStatus), and tracks available slots.
Version:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Internship

      public Internship(int id, String title, String desc, String major, InternshipLevel level, CompanyRep rep, String company, int slot, LocalDate open, LocalDate close)
      Constructs a new Internship. By default, status is set to PENDING and visibility is false.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique ID for the internship, from InternshipStore.
      title - The title of the internship.
      desc - A description of the role.
      major - The preferred major for applicants.
      level - The InternshipLevel (BASIC, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED).
      rep - The CompanyRep who created this internship.
      company - The name of the company.
      slot - The total number of available slots.
      open - The date applications open.
      close - The date applications close.

    • addFilledSlot

      public void addFilledSlot()
      Increments the filled slot count. Called when a student accepts an application for this internship. Automatically marks the internship as FILLED if all slots are taken.

    • removeFilledSlot

      public void removeFilledSlot()
      Decrements the filled slot count. Called when a student's accepted application is withdrawn and approved. Automatically marks the internship as APPROVED if it was previously FILLED.
